subject: Question on analysis of targeted regions from data generated from Agilent targted capture assay

messages.author: f212d819bbc8991b
messages.subject: Question on analysis of targeted regions from data generated from Agilent targted capture assay
parts:
Hi,

 

Could I please be adviced on how I might be able to target my analysis to targeted capture regions using MethylKit? I am new to this package and R so I am still in the process of exploring the functions. I used Bismark and bowtie2 for alignment and a perl script from Bismark for deduplication. I tried using bedtools intersect to extract targeted region from my sam files. I later found out that this process affects paired end reads and is therefore not compatible with the read.bismark function in methylkit. As such, I was wondering if there might be a way in methylkit to focus the analysis only on targeted regions?

 

Thanks
